newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse slightly down, little change seen.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse slightly down, little change seen.

text.p: The Bucharest bourse closed slightly weaker on Monday and brokers said it was likely to remain stable during the summer holiday period.

"The market is taking a break after almost two months with sharp rises," one trader said. He made no forecast on how the consolidation phase would continue but said a new bullish mood would set in next month.

On Monday, investors focused on first-tier refrigerator maker Arctic ACTB.BX, which rejoined trading on the Bucharest bourse on Friday after being suspended for more than a month. Brokers predicted continued interest in coming days.

"Buyers have trained their sights on Arctic, but overall demand and supply was balanced," one trader said. Arctic closed 200 lei up from the previous session at 3,400. It rebounded after first falling to 3,050 from an opening price of 3,300.

Chemical plant Oltchim inched down 50 lei to 3,950 in late trades, but some operators said they conducted a few deals at 4,000 at midsession. They said Oltchim would be stable in coming days at prices ranging between 3,900 and 4,000 lei.
Policolor dye maker also closed 50 lei down at 6,500 under strong selling presure. Otelinox ONOX.BX steel mill firmed 1,000 lei to 60,000, in low volumes.
Pharmaceutical plant Terapia gained 100 lei in late trading and closed at 9,400. Antibiotice ATBE.BX another drug maker ended flat at 7,500.
Three independent indices. the VAB, the BIG and the CAS-SE, based on average prices and market capitalisation, drifted down by 0.6, 0.57 and 0.57 percent respectively from Friday.
